identification.summary: Obsidian Sandstorm is a Microsoft threat actor name. Microsoft's public naming mapping lists its origin as Iran and gives no other names [S1].
identification.notes: Microsoft name: Obsidian Sandstorm (origin Iran; 'Other names' field empty) [S1]. No MITRE ATT&CK group, vendor alias or public campaign reporting could be linked to this name in open sources. Do not merge it with other Iranian Sandstorm clusters such as Peach, Mint, Mango, Cotton, Lemon or Pink Sandstorm.

attribution.confidence: Microsoft lists the origin as Iran [S1]. No public Microsoft statement linking the actor to a sponsoring organization (IRGC, MOIS or a contractor) was found.
attribution.basis: Microsoft threat actor naming mapping only [S1].
